subject: Uptake schedule & token bridging — MAP + eval acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwork.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: maria.espinoza@zenwork.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — MAP & evaluation plan

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. ZenWork wants to lock a short MAP so we can run an aggressive evaluation and get to a commercial decision by end of Q3. Two asks from my side: (1) a concrete monthly token/TPM acceptance trajectory we can commit to for budgeting, and (2) a bridge/credit mechanism if we under-index in month 1 but catch up later.

High level constraints: legal wants a predictable pricing ladder tied to committed monthly throughput (so they can model COGS), and our platform team needs clear acceptance criteria for production cutover (latency P95, KV cache behavior, and retry budgets).

Do you have a draft MAP with milestones and the pricing ladder we can review? If helpful, Maria (cc'd) will be the legal reviewer.

Thanks —
Alex
Senior Product Lead
ZenWork

Attachments: none
From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwork.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, maria.espinoza@zenwork.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Uptake schedule & token bridging — MAP + eval acceptance criteria

Alex —

Great framing. I've attached a working MAP draft (zenwork_map_draft_v3.pdf) and our Q2 pricing sheet. Summary of the proposal below — designed to keep you flexible while giving finance a predictable ladder:

Proposed MAP milestones (high-level)
- P0 (Week 0–2): Pilot activation — smoke tests, ingress validation, KV cache primer
- P1 (Weeks 3–8): Evaluation pilot — feature validation against your 10 prompt families, success if accuracy >= baseline and P95 latency <= 450ms for served traffic
- P2 (Months 2–6): Staggered ramp to committed throughput with monthly TPM gates
- P3 (Month 7+): Full commit/renewal (optional annual pricing)

Commit & ramp (monthly tokens — example schedule)
- Month 1 (pilot month): 400,000 tokens (soft target; bridge credits available)
- Month 2: 1,200,000 tokens
- Month 3: 3,000,000 tokens
- Month 4: 6,000,000 tokens
- Month 5: 9,000,000 tokens
- Month 6: 12,000,000 tokens (target steady state)

Bridge/credit mechanism
- If actual tokens in Month 1 are under the 400k target, Redwood provides a one-time bridging credit applied to Month 2 consumption (up to 50% of shortfall). The credit is conditional on meeting ramp milestones in Month 2 and 3.

Discounts tied to committed annualized volume
- If ZenWork signs a committed 12-month plan at >= 60M tokens/year, Redwood will apply a tiered discount (starting at 10% at 30M/year and up to 18% at >= 90M/year). Specifics in attached pricing sheet.

Operational acceptance criteria (for P1->P2 cutover)
- P95 latency <= 450ms across 95% of endpoints (non-experimental routes excluded)
- Error rate <= 0.5% sustained over a 1-hour window
- Consumable audit logs for first 60 days (KMS-integrated)
- On-call rotation and runbook handover by Redwood infra team prior to P2

Next steps
1) Confirm the acceptance criteria and the example monthly token schedule above (we can re-tier the months).
2) Maria — if you can flag any legal must-haves we should bake in (data residency/SLA exception asks) we'll revise.
3) If agreed, we'll incorporate these milestones into the MAP doc and send a DocuSign envelope for the staged-commit addendum (DocuSign link to follow).

I'll hold a short sync on Monday to walk through the MAP if that works for you.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: zenwork_map_draft_v3.pdf, redwood_pricing_sheet_q2.xlsx
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwork.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, maria.espinoza@zenwork.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Uptake schedule & token bridging — MAP + eval acceptance criteria

Alex / Maria —

Following up with a commercial proposal tweak from Redwood leadership to reduce friction on signing:

- We can increase the Month 1 soft target to 600k tokens if ZenWork commits to the Month 3 minimum (3M). That gives you more runway in the pilot and reduces bridge reliance.
- Bridge credits: change to 100% of shortfall up to a cap of 300k tokens (applies only to Month 2; must meet Month 3 cadence).
- We will include a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of Month 2 committed spend if technical acceptance criteria are met in P1 within the 8-week window.

Notes on legal/ops asks: we can accept a 60-day audit-log retention for the pilot instead of 12 months, but any longer retention will need the private deployment addendum (we can provide an exception request doc—attached: sla_exception_request.docx).

If these changes look OK to ZenWork, Olga — please prepare the MAP with updated numbers and we will issue a redlined staged-commit addendum for signature. Maria — any immediate concerns on the discount ladder?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none (pricing updated in the sheet Olga shared)

Subject: Re: Uptake schedule & token bridging — MAP + eval acceptance criteria

Marissa / Olga —

Thanks — that adjusted ladder makes the forecast cleaner for finance. We agree in principle to the Month 1 -> Month 3 guardrails you outlined. A few follow-ups before we sign the staged-commit: 

1) Can you add a clause that bridge credits are automatically applied within 30 days to our next invoice and are visible in the billing breakdown?
2) Legal (Maria) will request simple language around data processing (a short Addendum referencing Redwood's data handling docs). Please expect redlines there.
3) Can Redwood commit to a one-week rollback window post-cutover (if critical run-rate regressions are observed) as part of the operational runbook?

If you can reflect #1 and #3 in the addendum, we will route the MAP + staged-commit to legal for a final review. Please send the DocuSign when ready.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get going.

Best,
Alex
Senior Product Lead, ZenWork
